name: trust-label
description: Labels text that came from outside (web pages, search results, issues and PRs, logs, browser pages, MCP services) with where it came from, beside the tool's result, and flags candidate instructions hidden in it; a heuristic, never a judgement that a text is safe; /trust

labelAll.title: Label every external result
labelAll.description: Put a one-line source label beside every external result; off, only results with suspicious candidates get a note
